vocabulary.definition: a widespread occurrence of an infectious disease in a community at a particular time
vocabulary.example: The COVID-19 pandemic is an ongoing global epidemic that has affected millions of people.

vocabulary.definition: specialized cells transmitting nerve impulses in the brain and nervous system
vocabulary.example: Damage to neurons can result in impaired cognitive function and motor skills.

vocabulary.definition: proteins released by cells in response to the presence of pathogens such as viruses
vocabulary.example: Interferons play a crucial role in activating the immune system to fight off viral infections.

vocabulary.definition: allowing light to pass through so that objects behind can be distinctly seen
vocabulary.example: The glass windows of the exhibit were transparent, giving visitors a clear view of the artifacts inside.

vocabulary.definition: out of control; disordered or chaotic
vocabulary.example: The malfunctioning software caused the system to go haywire, leading to data loss.

vocabulary.definition: inflammation of the brain, usually caused by infection
vocabulary.example: The patient was diagnosed with encephalitis after exhibiting symptoms of severe headache and confusion.
